aarti.tek: Victory to Mother Sarasvatī; Mother, victory to Mother Sarasvatī. Rich in virtue and splendour, you are renowned in the three worlds.
aarti.pad1: Moon-faced and seated on a lotus, you have a radiance that brings blessing. The auspicious swan you ride adorns you, and you bear a matchless splendour. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: In your left hand is the vīṇā, in your right a rosary; a jewelled crown graces your head, and a string of pearls your neck. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: O Goddess, whoever came to your refuge, you delivered them. You entered the maid Mantharā and brought about the destruction of Rāvaṇa. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Giver of learning and knowledge, fill us with the light of knowledge. Rid the world of delusion, ignorance and darkness. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Incense, a lamp, fruit and dried fruits: Mother, accept them. Give us the eye of knowledge, Mother, and deliver the world. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings Mother Sarasvatī's āratī, which brings good and happiness, gains knowledge and devotion. ॥6॥
